# Superseded Polaris pixel star

The renderer, header tests and specification here preserve the first Polaris pixel-star design before the thin microcircuit hybrid. Source baseline: cce03f2af5474e4b234e62dc26ea27ea297d91ea. No history was rewritten.

The previous executable and matching manifests are archived under dist/legacy-polaris-pixel/68bf2a4ca77c; SHA256 68bf2a4ca77cc8ce4a6a15c1df39249f0cead1c2fd21e094f68f30108a2e4b7d. The original Nvvi chip and palette remain in ../legacy-nvvi.

These are historical sources and evidence. The active design is documented in ../../header-logo.md.
